stops.date_confidence: the refusal of exemption is attested by a contemporary JTA report of 9 December 1940. The visit to the local commissariat, and the exact wording said to have been entered on the form, are [R]: transmitted tradition, never produced from the original document. Vichy's Statut des Juifs is dated 3 October 1940 and the exemption clause for exceptional scientific merit belongs to the statute of 18 October, so the registration falls in the autumn; the day is unknown and defaults to 01. The coordinate is the Passy quarter of the 16th arrondissement and is approximate.
notes: hard triggers (traditional) discounted: the day is explicitly attested and their clause names no date, year, month or number (it concerns the pin, the house or the sources)

stops.segment: Boulevard de Beauséjour
stops.stop: 47 boulevard de Beauséjour, the night of the third
stops.date_confidence: CONTRADICTION KEPT OPEN. 3 January is given by English Wikipedia, French Wikipedia, SEP, and the Académie française's own biographical index page; 4 January is given by IEP, by Paul Valéry's memorial address of 9 January 1941 on the Académie's own site, and by 1914-1918-online. The Académie is internally inconsistent and cannot settle it, so the death falls in the night of 3-4 January 1941 and the file takes the 3rd only as its sortable value. Cause: pulmonary congestion per Valéry, bronchitis per Wikipedia, pneumonia per IEP.
notes: hard triggers (disputed) discounted: the day is explicitly attested and their clause names no date, year, month or number (it concerns the pin, the house or the sources)
soft triggers (year range) judged to concern the pin, the sources or the surrounding narrative, not the date, because the text cites the day
